cross_aggregate_interactions.pattern: linear / parallel / saga per coordination matrix

nb_persist_rules_to_enforce: NB-PERSIST-003: Technical events separate from Domain Events
NB-PERSIST-005: Events defined by Commands not UI
NB-PERSIST-006: Immutable Log exclusive to AuditAggregate
NB-PERSIST-008: Repository never blocks user-facing ops during sync
NB-PERSIST-009: No inter-aggregate dependencies at persistence level
NB-PERSIST-010: No technology in Domain layer
NB-PERSIST-012: Optimistic concurrency on all shared data
nb_rr_rules_to_enforce: NB-RR-001: No physical structure changes Aggregate boundary
NB-RR-002: No business logic in physical structures
NB-RR-005: Physical relation direction matches Domain navigation
NB-RR-007: Only AuditAggregate uses Immutable Log pattern
nb_id_rules: NB-ID-001: Natural identifiers never renamed or modified
NB-ID-002: Surrogate identifiers never reused after deletion
NB-ID-003: Identifier scope stays within Aggregate
NB-ID-004: Composed identifier component order is immutable
nb_mt_rules: NB-MT-001: No physical object without valid _org_id
NB-MT-002: No physical query without _org_id filter
NB-MT-004: _org_id of an object never changed after creation
lifecycle_invariants: LV-002: No requests accepted before Phase 106 completion
LV-004: No data loss during shutdown
LV-005: Shutdown order is reverse of initialization
LV-007: Restart after shutdown starts from Phase 100
LV-008: Diagnostic snapshot before every shutdown
LV-009: Shutdown audit entry always written

ambiguities.description: ITS-V1 specifies PostgreSQL 16+ (Supabase) as database target but also lists WatermelonDB for offline. Both use Prisma 5+ ORM. Prisma's SQLite adapter may conflict with PostgreSQL 16+ target — clarification needed on dual-database ORM configuration.

RTS-001 defines 17 Ports but some aggregate port usage matrices reference ports not explicitly covered by application service specs. Cross-reference PAS-001 coverage against ASS-001 Port Coverage Matrix required.

DOC-021 Physical Data Model lists 30 Physical Objects but POSTGRESQL-SCHEMA-PACK-v1.md defines 32 tables. Tables 31-33 are pending_operations, sync_statuses (OfflineSyncAggregate). Two additional tables likely from lifecycle or configuration aggregates. Clarification on 2 extra tables needed.

traceability_guarantee: Every aggregate documented above traces through ALL artifact layers: API Contract -> App Service -> Commands/Queries -> Domain Events -> Aggregate boundary -> Invariant guards -> DB tables -> Ports -> Runtime Components. Each element is referenced to its canonical source document ID.
